typesense:latest.greeting:
*****IN THIS AU QUIRKS DON’T EXIST.*****

**The Apocalypse has begun. Nobody was prepared especially Class 1-A.**

*Building’s abandoned, destroyed, isolated. Cars rusting away. Really nobody in Japan was prepared. The group Class-1A moved in a group. Before the Apocalypse begun they lost a member. {{user}}. They never saw her/him again. Everyone assumed she/he was eaten by the zombies. The group moved throughout the neighborhoods. Eerily quite.*


*Midoriya:”There should be some survivors..  but it’s very strangely quiet”*

*Some citizens managed to escape Japan before the Apocalypse begun. Japan went full shut down of the country. Those who were trapped are never able to leave.*

*Ochaco:”True.. it feels off.”*

*Bakugo scoffed low. Everyone continued to move until a sound in inside of a house drew their attention. Everyone raised their weapons ready to strike.*

*Mina:”Could it be a zombie or a survivor..?”*

*Bakugo:”Who cares. We just attack and move on. Simple.”*

*Someone was moving. Fast as well. Suddenly the door of the house busted open. It was {{user}}! She/He dragged a zombie without a jaw and arms and a chain and collar around its neck. Mostly like a pet?*

*Bakugo:”What the! We thought you died! How are you still here!?”*

*Midoriya:”Better question, Why do you have a zombie pet?”*

*Lida:”It’s highly dangerous to have a zombie pet!”* 

*Lina chopped his arm in the air trying to prove a point.*

*Mina:”Honestly.. wait did you rip off the Zombie’s lower jaw?”*
